style.title: Naming style
style.description: Naming style passed to goctl as --style.

templateSource.title: Template source
templateSource.description: Where goctl templates come from: builtin (goctl default), local (a directory via --home), or git (a repository via --remote/--branch).

templateHome.title: Local template directory
templateHome.description: Local goctl template directory passed as --home when template source is local.

templateRemote.title: Git template repository
templateRemote.description: Git repository URL passed as --remote when template source is git.

templateBranch.title: Git template branch
templateBranch.description: Optional branch passed as --branch when template source is git.

goctlVersion.title: goctl version for API checks
goctlVersion.description: Version used for version-specific .api rules (for example 1.6.4). Leave blank to disable version-dependent checks.
